noCalendarSet: Select a crop and sowing date to see your task schedule.
taskCottonSowing: Sow cotton seeds 60-70 cm row spacing. Treat seeds with Imidacloprid.
taskCottonIrr1: Light irrigation 3 days after sowing for germination.
taskCottonThinning: Remove weak seedlings. Keep one healthy plant per spot.
taskCottonFert1: Apply Urea 50 kg/acre for vegetative growth.
taskCottonIrr2: Second irrigation at 25 days for root establishment.
taskCottonSpray1: Spray Profenophos for sucking pests. Check for jassids & thrips.
taskCottonFert2: Apply DAP 50 kg/acre at square formation stage.
taskCottonIrr3: Third irrigation at 55 days during boll development.
taskCottonSpray2: Spray Chlorantraniliprole for bollworm if damage seen.
taskCottonSpray3: Apply copper oxychloride for fungal diseases. Monitor pink bollworm.
taskCottonHarvest: First picking of open bolls. Harvest in morning. Grade cotton.
taskCottonHarvest2: Second picking. Clear field after harvest. Deep plough.
taskGndSowing: Sow groundnut seeds 30×10 cm spacing. Apply Rhizobium culture.
taskGndIrr1: First irrigation 4 days after sowing for germination.
taskGndFert1: Apply SSP 250 kg/acre for phosphorus and calcium.
taskGndWeeding: Manual weeding or use Imazethapyr herbicide.
taskGndSpray1: Spray Chlorothalonil for early leaf spot disease.
taskGndFert2: Gypsum 200 kg/acre at pegging stage for pod development.
taskGndSpray2: Spray Mancozeb for late leaf spot. Check for white grub.
taskGndHarvest: Harvest when 75% pods mature. Dry in shade for 3-4 days.
taskWhtSowing: Sow wheat seeds 22-25 kg/acre with 20 cm row spacing.
taskWhtIrr1: Crown root irrigation — critical first irrigation after sowing.
taskWhtFert1: Top-dress Urea 50 kg/acre at tillering stage.
taskWhtIrr2: Tillering irrigation at 21 days. Maintain good moisture.
taskWhtFert2: Apply Urea 25 kg/acre at jointing stage.
taskWhtIrr3: Jointing irrigation — critical for grain filling.
taskWhtSpray1: Spray Propiconazole for yellow rust if stripe symptoms seen.
taskWhtIrr4: Grain filling irrigation at 63 days. Stop irrigation after milky stage.
taskWhtHarvest: Harvest at golden yellow stage. Threshing within 2 days.
taskBajraSowing: Sow bajra 2-3 seeds per hill, 45×15 cm spacing.
taskBajraIrr1: Light irrigation 5 days after sowing for uniform germination.
taskBajraFert1: Apply Urea 40 kg/acre at 21 days for tillering.
taskBajraSpray1: Spray Mancozeb for downy mildew. Check for stem borer.
taskBajraIrr2: Irrigation at flowering — critical for grain development.
taskBajraHarvest: Harvest when heads turn brown. Dry and thresh. Store in cool dry place.
taskCastorSowing: Sow castor seeds 90×60 cm spacing. Treat seeds with Thiram.
taskCastorFert1: Apply Urea 40 kg/acre + SSP 100 kg/acre at 25 days.
taskCastorFert2: Second dose Urea 20 kg/acre at branching stage.
taskCastorHarvest: Harvest when capsules turn brown. Dry for 5-7 days before threshing.
taskCuminSowing: Broadcast cumin seeds 8-10 kg/acre. Light raking to cover seeds.
taskCuminIrr1: Light sprinkler irrigation 3 days after sowing — avoid waterlogging.
taskCuminFert1: Apply DAP 30 kg/acre + Urea 20 kg/acre at 20 days.
taskCuminSpray1: Spray Carbendazim for powdery mildew. Monitor aphids.
taskCuminSpray2: Spray Mancozeb + Chlorpyrifos mix for blight and stem fly.
taskCuminHarvest: Harvest when 70% plants turn golden yellow. Dry, thresh, winnow.

helpHeroSub: Find answers, contact support, or browse tips.
faqQ1: How does the weather data work?
faqA1: FarmerApp uses Open-Meteo for real-time 7-day forecasts and NASA POWER satellites for historical climate analysis. Data is refreshed automatically.
faqA2: Crops are matched to your location's average temperature, rainfall, and humidity using climate data from NASA POWER. Recommendations update when you change your location.
faqQ3: How do I change my location?
faqA3: Tap the location badge on the home screen or in the side menu, then search or use GPS to set a new location.
faqA4: Alerts fire when max temperature exceeds 40°C (heat stress), daily rainfall exceeds 50 mm (flood risk), or wind speed exceeds 15 m/s (storm warning).
faqQ5: Can I use the app in Gujarati or Hindi?
faqA5: Yes! Tap the language buttons (EN / ગુ / हि) in the side menu to switch languages instantly. Your preference is saved automatically.
faqA6: All weather data comes from public APIs (NASA & Open-Meteo). Your profile and login information is stored locally on your device.
helpTip1: Pull down on any screen to refresh data with the latest readings.
helpTip2: Change your location to the nearest town or village for more accurate crop advice.
helpTip3: Check the Alerts screen every morning before going to the field.
helpTip4: Use the Historical screen to compare this season's rainfall with previous years.
